title: Type the durable default of the common.compat ResumableJobMixin stand-in as bool | None
decision: Type the durable default of the common.compat ResumableJobMixin stand-in as bool | None
why: bool | None is what the argument actually takes and matches the operators using the mixin which already declare durable: bool | None = None and only forward durable when it is not None
quote: `bool | Any` or `Any` would also be honest, but a union with `Any` switches type checking off for the argument, so `durable="yes"` would pass.
